articles.title: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
articles.description: He becomes the first person to win two lead acting prizes in one night at the prestigious TV ceremony.

articles.title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace
articles.description: The origin of the drone is currently unknown, but authorities say it likely entered Lithuania from neighbouring Belarus, an ally of Russia.

articles.title: Zambians warned not to eat dead wildlife after anthrax kills dozens of animals
articles.description: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.

articles.title: Early results in Swedish election show one-seat advantage for left bloc
articles.description: Preliminary results in Sweden's national election are indicating a narrow one-seat advantage for the left-wing opposition over Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing coalition.

articles.title: Drone alert over Lithuania turns out to be flock of birds - as NATO jet scrambled
articles.description: A NATO fighter jet was scrambled after a possible drone sighting in Lithuanian airspace - but it turned out to be a flock of birds.
